senses.definition: (informal) A great distance in space or time.
examples: His final shot missed the bullseye by miles.
From the top of the hill you can see for miles.
No need to hurry. The deadline is miles away.

senses.definition: (informal) much; a lot (used to emphasise a comparative)
examples: Her new paintings are miles better than her older ones.

quotes.text: "Your voice is certainly miles different," admitted Nickle grudgingly and staring very hard. "Look here—do you actually mean to say that you aren't Geoffrey Tilehurst?"
